lcc_original: 至於地上各樣走獸、空中各樣飛鳥、和爬在地上的各樣活物、裏面有生命的、我卻將菜蔬所有的青葉子給他們做食物：』就這樣成了。
notes: First two creature groups: lamed prefix {<WAH09001>} stays implicit (no explicit word in LCC); 各樣 is explicit for כָּל so braces dropped → 各樣<WAH03605>.
Third creature group: LCC reorders to 爬在地上的各樣活物 — tags follow LCC word order, so 各樣<WAH09001><WAH03605> lands after 地上 instead of before 爬.
Hebrew נֶפֶשׁ חַיָּה (WH05315 + WH02416) is split across two LCC clauses: 活物 takes WH05315 (the creature/noun), 生命 in 裏面有生命的 takes WH02416 (the living/life qualifier).
LCC 裏面 is an explicit rendering of Hebrew בּוֹ ({<WAH09002>}), so braces dropped: 裏面<WAH09002>. The relative pronoun אֲשֶׁר {<WAH0834>} remains implicit — no explicit word in LCC.

Food clause: LCC expands 青草 (green herb) into 菜蔬所有的青葉子. 菜蔬 takes WH06212 (עֵשֶׂב), 所有 takes WAH03605 (כָּל, explicit in LCC so braces dropped), 青 takes WH03418 (יֶרֶק); 葉子 is a Chinese expansion with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated.
我卻將<WAH0853>: WAH0853 (אֵת, direct object marker) attaches to 將, parallel to UNV's 我將<WAH0853>.
